column1: # The subset of conformance/UNBACKED.tsv for which a multi-agent triage, with an
# adversarial verifier per row, confirmed a REAL TEST WITH TEETH can be written
# TODAY (against the current spec + harness). "Teeth" = there is a plausible wrong
# implementation the test catches; a tautology does not qualify.
# 72 clauses survived verification (of 239 checked; 70% of candidates were refuted
# and reclassified as blocked-on-a-spec-decision, no-teeth, or a document lint).
# This is a FLOOR, not a ceiling: only the top ~30 candidates per sub-standard were
# verified, so the true workable count is higher - but every row here is checked.
# status DONE = a test with teeth now backs it (struck from UNBACKED.tsv).
# Pick a `todo` row, write the test the clause names, cite the clause, run the gate.
